subject.title: fix(openshell): bound sandbox readFile with size cap

question: Should OpenShell mirror-mode sandbox reads adopt a fixed 100 MiB compatibility boundary for all existing users?
rationale: The code correctly uses the shared safe-read primitive, but the numerical limit changes an existing successful-read behavior and no maintainer decision establishes that 100 MiB is the intended permanent product boundary.

options.title: Accept the fixed 100 MiB boundary
options.body: Approve the limit as the OpenShell mirror-read safety contract and retain the shared `fs-safe` implementation.

options.title: Choose another owner-defined policy
options.body: Pause this PR until the OpenShell owner specifies a different supported size boundary or migration/product behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the fixed 100 MiB boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the limit as the OpenShell mirror-read safety contract and retain the shared `fs-safe` implementation.
